name: wiz-ecc-codex
description: Generic WIZ Codex harness with ECC skills, WIZ sub-agents, command prompts, MCP configs, and WIZ MCP integration.

interface.shortDescription: Codex baseline for WIZ projects with ECC skills and WIZ MCP.
interface.longDescription: A path-independent Codex baseline that packages ECC skills, WIZ framework instructions, WIZ-native sub-agents, command prompt shims, MCP configs, and a WIZ MCP launcher for any active WIZ workspace.
defaultPrompt: Treat this as a generic WIZ harness, not as the target application repository.
Use wiz_workspace_status to identify the active WIZ workspace and currentProject before editing.
Use WIZ MCP tools first when working inside WIZ source, package, and project paths.
Use bundled WIZ instructions from the installed harness assets and target workspace custom instructions when present.
Preserve currentProject boundaries and never modify another WIZ project without an explicit project switch.
